text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend eight candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.

City Council on February 7 and 8, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following eight candidates to the Toronto Public Library Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Tamara Balan Justice Faith Betty Serda Evren Jonathan Hoss Dhruv Jain Amina Mohamed Alim Remtulla Soo Wong 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1-3 to the report (January 24, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
